title: Komi Can't Communicate
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shoko Komi, admired at her elite high school as elegant and aloof, actually has extreme social anxiety. Her ordinary classmate Tadano notices and helps her toward her goal of making 100 friends.
life_message: It holds up patience, kindness and friendship as ways to help someone find their voice.
